title: PL/SQL Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Write a message
entries.summary: An anonymous block has BEGIN and END. DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE writes a line for the client to show.
notes: Enable server output or the client may hide the message.

entries.name: Name a number
entries.summary: DECLARE introduces local values. := assigns a value.
notes: Assignment uses :=, while = is a comparison.

entries.name: Join pieces of text
entries.summary: VARCHAR2 holds text. Two vertical bars join text.
notes: Use single quotes for text literals.

entries.name: Choose an action
entries.summary: IF checks a rule. END IF ends its branches.
notes: Close an IF with END IF, not only END.

entries.name: Choose from labels
entries.summary: CASE matches a value with labels. ELSE is a fallback.
notes: Without an ELSE, an unmatched statement CASE can raise an error.

entries.name: Count with a FOR loop
entries.summary: A numeric FOR loop creates a counter and includes both ends.
notes: Do not assign a new value to the FOR loop counter.

entries.name: Repeat while a rule is true
entries.summary: WHILE checks its rule before each repetition.
notes: Update the counter so the loop can stop.

entries.name: Group named fields
entries.summary: A record groups related values into one local data item.
notes: Set a field before assuming it has a useful value.

entries.name: Use a named lookup
entries.summary: An associative array stores values by key. This one uses text keys.
notes: Use EXISTS before reading a key that may be absent.

entries.name: Return a result
entries.summary: A local function gives reusable steps a name and returns a typed value.
notes: A function must return a value on its successful path.

entries.name: Handle a known error
entries.summary: EXCEPTION handles a failure in the block. ZERO_DIVIDE is the name for division by zero.
notes: Handle a named expected error rather than silently hiding all errors.

entries.name: Use a fallback for NULL
entries.summary: NULL means no value. NVL chooses a fallback when its first input is NULL.
notes: Test missing values with IS NULL, not = NULL.
